newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec chain store sales up 36.8 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec chain store sales up 36.8 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Sales at chain stores in Japan in December were up 36.8 percent from the previous month at 1.87 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores' Association said on Friday.
Year-on-year, chain store sales posted a 0.4 percent fall in December.
Sales at chain stores in the whole of 1996 amounted to 16.70 trillion yen, up 0.2 pct from the previous year, the association said.
The year-on-year fall in sales in December was due to sluggish sales of winter clothing because of unusually mild weather during the month, it said in a statement.
Sales in the year-end shopping period did not grow much either, it said.
The December survey covered 7,923 outlets of 132 firms.
